reason: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to Notion through the official Notion MCP server, including OAuth login, token refresh, search, reading, and writing of Notion content.

summaries.zh: 通过官方 Notion MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness agent 连接到 Notion，支持 OAuth 授权以及页面、数据库和评论的搜索、读取与写入。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to Notion through the official Notion MCP server with OAuth authorization and tools for searching, reading, and writing pages, databases, and comments.

capabilities: Connects to the Notion MCP server over the network
Performs OAuth 2.0 authorization with PKCE and stores refreshable access credentials
Exposes Notion search, page, database, and comment tools to the dsh agent
Can write content to Notion pages, databases, and comments
Runs a local HTTP callback service on 127.0.0.1 for OAuth completion
